spans.s:
पिण्ड् पिण्ड् (probably akin to rt. पिष्;
considered by some as a Nom. fr. पिण्ड
below), cl. 1. A., 10. P. पिण्डते, पिण्डितुम्, पिण्-
डयति, -यितुम्, to roll into a lump or ball, to put
together, join, unite; to accumulate; to assemble.

पिण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. (in most senses usually m.),
a round mass, ball, globe, lump, knob, clod (e. g.
अयः-पिण्ड, a ball or lump of iron; अग्नि-पिण्डौ,
the knobs at the end of a pair of tongs; cf. नेत्र-प्˚,
मृत्-प्˚); a roundish lump of food, a bite, morsel,
mouthful; a cake or ball of meal offered to the
Manes, a ball or lump of meat or rice mixed up with
milk, curds, flowers, &c., and offered at the several
Śrāddhas to the Manes by the nearest surviving
relations (= नि-वाप); food; sustenance, means of
living, livelihood, subsistence [cf. पर-पिण्डाद];
alms; flesh, meat; the embryo or fetus in an early
stage of gestation; the body; the projection of an
elephant's frontal sinus; a round button; anything
roundish, thick, gross, or solid; thickness (one of
the three dimensions in geometry); a heap, cluster,
quantity, collection; an object; a particular part of
a house; a sort of portico or shed in front of the
door; myrrh, incense, frankincense; the side imme-
diately below the armpit (?); Vangueria Spinosa; the
flower of the China rose; (in arithmetic) sum, total
amount; (in astronomy) a sine expressed in numbers
[cf. ज्या-प्˚]; the twenty-fourth part of the quadrant
of a circle, or 3° 45; N. of a man; (औ), m. du. the
fleshy parts of the shoulder situated above the collar-
bone; (अम्), n. power, might; an army; iron;
fresh butter; (ई), f. a round mass, &c. (= पिण्ड, m.);
a long gourd, Cucurbita Lagenaria (= अ-लाबु); a
species of date tree; the flowering shrub Tabernæ-
montana Coronaria (= तगर); the plant Jonesia
Aśoka; a species of palm, Phœnix Dactylifera; the
nave of a wheel; performance of certain gesticulations
during the silent repetition of prayers while medi-
tating on real or divine knowledge; a house; N. of
a woman.
—पिण्ड-कन्द, अस्, m. a species of
bulbous plant (= पिण्डालु).
—पिण्ड-खर्जूर, अस्,
m. or पिण्ड-खर्जूरिका or पिण्ड-खर्जूरी, f. a
species of date tree.
—पिण्ड-गोस, अस्, m. gum
myrrh.
—पिण्ड-तर्कुक, आस्, m. pl., Ved. the
ancestors preceding the great-grandfather (who eat
the remnants of the oblations made to the Manes).
—पिण्ड-तस्, ind. from a ball or lump.
—पिण्ड-
तैल, अम्, n. or पिण्ड-तैलक, अस्, m. incense,
olibanum.
—पिण्ड-त्व, अम्, n. the being a lump or
ball; पिण्डत्वं गम्, to attain the condition of a
lump.
—पिण्ड-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving or qualified to
give the funeral cake to deceased ancestors; supplying
with bread or with the means of subsistence; (अस्),
m. the nearest male relation who offers the funeral
cake; a patron, master.
—पिण्ड-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ,
one who gives or is qualified to give the funeral
cake to deceased ancestors.
—पिण्ड-दान, अम्, n.
offering a cake of meal (especially in the oblation to
the Manes); presentation of the obsequial cake; the
funeral oblation made to deceased ancestors on the
evening of new moon.
—पिण्ड-निर्वपण, अम्,
n. presenting obsequial cakes to the Manes, the
sacrifice to the Manes.
—पिण्ड-पद, अम्, n. a
kind of arithmetical calculation.
—पिण्ड-पात, अस्,
m. giving alms.
—पिण्डपातिक, अस्, m. one who
lives on alms.
—पिण्ड-पात्र, अम्, n. the vessel in
which the obsequial cakes are offered to the Manes;
alms (lit. an alms-dish).
—पिण्ड-पाद or पिण्ड-
पाद्य, अस्, m. ‘thick-footed,’ an elephant.
—पिण्ड-
पितृ-यज्ञ, अम्, n., Ved. the oblation of obsequial
cakes to deceased ancestors on the evening of new
moon.
—पिण्ड-पुष्प, अस्, m. the tree Jonesia
Aśoka; the China rose; the pomegranate tree;
(अम्), n. the blossom of the Aśoka tree; the flower
of the China rose; a lotus; the flower of the plant
Tabernæmontana Coronaria.
—पिण्डपुष्पक,
अस्, m. a kind of vegetable, Chenopodium Album.
—पिण्ड-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing (long) round
fruits; (आ), f. a bitter gourd.
—पिण्ड-बीज or पिण्ड-
वीज, अस्, m. a flowering shrub, Nerium (or Oleander)
Odorum.
—पिण्डबीजक, अस्, m. Pterospermum
[]
Acerifolium (= कर्णिकार).
—पिण्ड-भाज्, क्, क्, क्,
partaking of a funeral oblation, entitled to a share
in the funeral cake, eating or receiving the cakes
offered at a funeral ceremony; (जस्), m. pl. de-
ceased ancestors, the Manes.
—पिण्ड-भृति, इस्,
f. means of subsistence, livelihood.
—पिण्ड-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of a lump (of clay).
—पिण्ड-
मात्रोपजीविन् (˚र-उप्˚), ई, इनी, इ, subsisting on a
mere morsel.
—पिण्ड-मुस्ता, f. a species of grass,
Cyperus Pertenuis.
—पिण्ड-मूल or पिण्ड-मू-
लक, अम्, n. a carrot, Daucus Carota (= गर्जर).
—पिण्ड-यज्ञ, अस्, m. the oblation of obsequial
cakes to deceased ancestors.
—पिण्ड-लेप, अस्, m.
the particles or fragments of the obsequial cakes
which cling to the hands, (these are offered to the
three ancestors preceding the great-grandfather.)
—पिण्ड-लोप, अस्, m. an interruption in offering
the funeral cake; a neglect of the solemn obsequies
in honour of deceased ancestors.
—पिण्ड-वत्, ind.
like a lump or ball.
—पिण्ड-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m.
relationship between a living person and one deceased
sufficiently near to qualify the former to offer the
obsequial cake to the latter; [cf. स-पिण्ड.]
—पिण्ड-
सम्बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, qualified by near relationship
to a living person to receive the obsequial cake from
him at the oblation to the Manes.
—पिण्ड-सेक्तृ,
ता, m., N. of a Nāga.
—पिण्ड-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. ‘mingled in a lump,’ mixed or intermingled
together.
—पिण्डान्वाहार्य (˚ड-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
to be eaten after the funeral cake has been offered
(Manu
III. 123

).
—पिण्डान्वाहार्यक, अम्, n.
(with श्राद्ध) a meal in honour of the Manes
after offering the funeral cakes.
—पिण्डाभ्र (˚ड-
अभ्˚), अम्, n. hail.
—पिण्डायस (˚ड-अय्˚), अम्,
n. steel.
—पिण्डालु (˚ड-आलु), उस्, m., N. of
two bulbous plants; = कन्द-गुडूची; an esculent
medicinal root described as sweet, cooling, and
diuretic (= Hindī peḍālu Bengālī cuvaḍiālu; in
this sense also पिण्डालुक, अम्, n.).
—पिण्डाश or
पिण्डाशक (˚ड-आश्˚), or पिण्डाशन (˚ड-अश्˚), अस्,
or पिण्डाशिन् (˚ड-आश्˚), ई, m. ‘eating morsels,’ a beg-
gar.
—पिण्डाह्वा (˚ड-आह्˚), f. the resin of Gardenia
Gummifera (= नाडी-हिङ्गु).
—पिण्डी-खण्ड, अस्,
or अम्, m. or n. (?), a small wood of Tabernæmontana
Coronaria trees (or of Aśoka trees).
—पिण्डी-जङ्घ,
अस्, m., N. of a man or of his descendants.
—पिण्डी-
तगर, अस्, m. a species of Tabernæmontana Coro-
naria (= कफ-वर्धन).
—पिण्डीतगरक, अस्,
m. Tabernæmontana Coronaria.
—पिण्डी-तरु, उस्,
m. a species of tree (= महा-प्˚).
—पिण्डी-पुष्प,
अम्, n. Jonesia Aśoka.
—पिण्डी-लेप, अस्, m. a kind
of unguent.
—पिण्डी-शूर, अस्, m. ‘a cake-hero,’ a
cowardly boaster, cotquean, braggart.
—पिण्डोदक-
क्रिया (˚ड-उद्˚), f. an oblation of obsequial cakes
and water.
—पिण्डोद्धरण (˚ड-उद्˚), अम्, n.
participating in funeral offerings, presenting them to
common ancestors.
—पिण्डोपनिषद् (˚ड-उप्˚), त्,
f., N. of an Upaniṣad.

पिण्डक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a lump, lump of food; a
round swelling or protuberance [cf. मस्तक-प्˚];
the calf of the leg; incense, myrrh; a species of
bulbous plant (= पिण्डालु); a carrot, Daucus Carota;
(in astronomy) a sine expressed in numbers; (अस्),
m. a Piśāca, goblin, demon; (इका), f. a globular
swelling or protuberance, a fleshy swelling (in the
shoulders, arms, legs, &c.), a wen (?); the calf of
the leg; the instep; the nave of a wheel; a stool
or seat of various shapes and dimensions; a base
or pedestal for the image of a deity or for a Liṅga
(Ved.); a kind of shrub (= श्वेताम्लि).

पिण्डन, अम्, n. forming globes, taking a globular
form (as water); (अस्), m. a mound or bank.
पिण्डरक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a bridge.

पिण्डारक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga; N. of a
Vṛṣṇi; of a son of Vasu-deva and Rohiṇī; of a
river considered holy by the Hindūs; (अम्), n., N.
of a place of pilgrimage in Guzerat.
—पिण्डारक-
तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.

पिण्डल, अस्, m. a bridge, causeway, passage over a
stream or ravine, a mound, ridge, balk raised to form a
path across inundated fields; [cf. पिण्डन, पिण्डिल.]

पिण्डस, अस्, m. a beggar, mendicant living upon
alms; [cf. पिण्डाश under पिण्ड.]
पिण्डात, अस्, m. incense.

पिण्डार, अस्, m. a beggar, religious mendicant;
a buffalo-herdsman, neatherd, cowherd; a species
[]
of tree, Flacourtia Sapida; Trewia Nudiflora; an
expression of censure; N. of a Nāga; (अम्), n.
a kind of vegetable (= Hindī पिण्डारा).

पिण्डि, इस्, f. the nave of a wheel (= पिण्डी,
पिण्डिका).

पिण्डिक, अस्, आ, अम्, having large calves (?). See
पिण्डिका under पिण्डक, col. 2.

पिण्डिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing a body (= शरीरिन्);
receiving cakes of meal (as ancestors &c.); possessing
the पिण्ड or funeral oblation; (ई), m. a beggar; an
offerer of obsequial oblations or cakes of meal to
the Manes.

पिण्डिल, अस्, आ, अम्, having large calves (=
स्थूल-जङ्घ); skilled in calculations; (अस्), m. a
skilful calculator or arithmetician, a calculator of nati-
vities, astrologer, astronomer; a bridge, mound, balk,
causeway; (आ), f. a species of cucumber, Cucumis
Maderaspatanus (= गोडुम्बा).

पिण्डी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make into a lump or ball, press together,
unite, join together, mix or intermingle; to con-
centrate; to identify with (with सह).
—पिण्डी-क-
रण, अम्, n. making into a lump or ball, heaping.
—पिण्डी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made into a lump or
ball.
—पिण्डी-कृत्य, ind. having made into a lump
or ball; having concentrated.

पिण्डीतक, अस्, m. the tree Vangueria Spinosa;
a kind of shrub, Tabernæmontana Coronaria; a
species of basil (= फणिज्झक); (अम्), n. the
fruit of the tree Vangueria Spinosa.

पिण्डी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to be
made into a lump or ball, to become a solid body.
—पिण्डी-भाव, अस्, m. the being rolled together
into a ball.
—पिण्डी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, formed into
a lump or ball, lumped, heaped.
पिण्डोल, अस्, m., N. of a man.

पिण्डोलि, इस्, f. leavings of a meal, fragments
dropped from the mouth, orts.

पिण्डिपाल पिण्डिपाल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
N. of a weapon with a single point; [cf. भिन्दि-
पाल.]

पिण्या पिण्या, f. heart-pea, Cardiosper-
mum Halicacabum (= पण्या).

पिण्याक पिण्याक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be
fr. rt. पिष्), the residue of seeds which have been
ground for oil; oil-cake; incense; saffron; Asa
Fœtida; (आ), f. a species of plant.
